This feature being broken has a pretty big impact. Since it cannot be controlled using the “now playing” feature, the functionality is extremely limited. I used to be able to start playing a scripture and go about doing housework and the like, and be able to pause or rewind as necessary in a convenient way, even pausing from my AirPods which was very helpful. I also used to be able to set timers for it to stop playing after a while so I could go to sleep listening to God’s Word, it was wonderful. I must admit I have absolutely no idea what purpose the built in timer serves. I keep setting it thinking it will do something but no, once the timer runs out it simply doesn’t say “timer” and count down anymore, no tone to alert you the timer is done, doesn’t stop playing, nothing. It took some testing to figure out what exactly was happening. After trial and error, I found that this timer only works to stop the readings if your screen is unlocked and the audio is currently being displayed on the screen as the timer runs out which means you cannot rely on it to work for nearly any application I can think of since your phone screen cannot navigate away or go dark or anything. I have also run into several instances where the reading restarted the book I was on instead of proceeding to the next book once all the chapters had been read. Please please fix this! I used this app (specifically the audio feature) every single day and night, and I truly loved it! Please fix! I miss the soothing sound of Max McClean reading scripture so very much.

The ads can be long, and sometimes don’t have an option to close, so I have to close & reopen Bible Gateway to get back to the verse. I know they offer a paid ad-free option, but this is ridiculous & I’m done. They need to come up with another way of advertising income stream other than the annoying pop-up ads. There’s plenty of other Bible apps out there.

Helpful app terrible ads. The ads are obnoxiously long, if you need money charge subscription or charge 10 or $20 for the app but make a version that doesn't have these stupid ads so that the little bit of time you have isn't taken up watching trash game ads, that you don't want.

reviews.text: TOO MANY ADS. Sad to leave Bible Gateway after having this app for more than a decade. The ads are now too many and too long to tolerate. Imagine reaching for the Word to start your day and being besieged by long ads just as you get going into your devotions. Held off from deleting because all my notes are here over the years but it has become insufferable and corrupt. This kind of commodification is the stuff of distraction and the very Bible cautions us to “Beware of the devices of the devil’

You should be ashamed of yourselves.. The constant commercials in the Lord’s Book is bad enough. But now?? Some of those commercials go against the very “app” you’ve put together. App deleted but thank you for the lesson about what can happen if you are not diligent.

Ads, Ads, Ads. So unbelievable that they would play ads with sound upon opening a Bible app. Can you not see how that’s a terrible setup? Say someone needs a quick reference in church and pulls out their Bible app and it starts playing out loud, even when the phone ringer is silenced, not only disturbing everyone around but also giving the impression that you’re just watching videos or something… who thought this was a good idea? Besides all that, the app is very buggy with freezes and blank screens requiring closing and reopening. Uninstalled.
